title: InvestigationRequestedV1
description: Triage opened a case and is asking for an investigation. Topic investigation.requested.v1, keyed by case_id because one message exists per case and the case is the entity that exists at produce time (docs/EVENT_CONTRACTS.md §3). Written to the transactional outbox in the SAME database transaction as the case and queue rows, so the event cannot announce a case that does not exist (ADR-0007).

case_id.description: The case this request is for. Distinct from an investigation_id: the case is what an analyst sees and exists at triage time, while an investigation is how the orchestrator runs and is created by the worker that leases it (ADR-0027).

risk_band.description: Only HIGH and CRITICAL open an investigation (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3). LOW and MEDIUM are absent from this enum deliberately: a message carrying one would mean triage fired when it should not have.

score.description: Combined rules score at triage time, bounded [0, 1].

rule_pack_digest.description: sha256 of the rule pack that produced the decision. Rules hot-reload, so without this a consumer cannot tell which behaviour opened the case.

threshold_config_digest.description: sha256 of the banding configuration in force at triage time.

feature_set_version.description: Semantic version of the online feature set (ADR-0032). A score produced by a different feature set is not comparable to one produced by this one.

feature_source.description: Whether the warm path had reconciled the features this decision read. Consumers must tolerate an unseen value (docs/EVENT_CONTRACTS.md §4).

degraded.description: True when the decision was made with a dependency unavailable. Every fail-open decision is tagged and counted (CLAUDE.md §3.7), and an investigation opened on degraded features is weaker evidence than one opened on complete features.

degraded_reasons.description: Why the decision was degraded, when it was.

fired_rule_ids.description: The rules that fired, so a consumer knows what to investigate without re-deriving the decision. Rule IDS ONLY: the feature values a predicate read stay in the synchronous response and the case record, because this topic is retained for 30 days and an event is a poor place for data that is already stored.

abstained_rule_count.description: How many rules could not reach a verdict because an input was absent. Carried so a consumer can tell a decision made with a blind pack from one made with a quiet one (ADR-0032, ADR-0033).
